def shift_matrix(N, k, s):
    h = 1.0 / N; m = int(np.floor(s / h + 1e-12)); r = s - m * h; S = np.zeros((N, N))
    for j in range(N):
        S[j, (j + m) % N] += 1.0 - r / h; S[j, (j + m + 1) % N] += r / h
    return S

assert np.allclose(nonlocal_dg_operator(N, k, alpha, delta, shift_matrix), target)
